name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, northwest Argentina. The project hosts one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally, with Measured and Indicated Resources of 232 Mt containing approximately 248 Moz silver and 2.54 Moz gold. The company has completed a Preliminary Feasibility Study and submitted a RIGI (Large Investment Incentive Regime) application to advance toward mine development.
